title: Neighbourhood Planning consultation — Harvington Village Hall
body: Drop in from 2pm to 4pm. We want to hear your views on the environment, recreation, community projects and what new housing in our village may look like. Come and help shape your vision for our village. Councillors available to talk to. Refreshments available. You can also hear the results of the recent housing needs survey, carried out by Wychavon District Council for the parish council, and sign up to join a Community Speedwatch team.

image.alt: Poster for Harvington's Neighbourhood Planning consultation: Saturday 28 November 2026, drop in 2 to 4pm in the village hall, councillors available to talk to, refreshments available
